DETAILS FROM THE INSTRUMENTS

Look a little closer.

Construction and component details below
come from the individual retailer listings.

01 / S-style

Grain with a presence.

A black limba body paired with a maple neck and fingerboard. This S-style listing specifies Fralin Blues Special pickups and super-jumbo Jescar stainless-steel frets.

Explore this instrument ↗

02 / Single & double cut

A carved approach.

The black-nitro 339-style listing pairs a carved flame-maple top with a carved flamed-mahogany back. Its documented details include a rosewood fingerboard, 24.75-inch scale, and Seymour Duncan ’59 pickups with Alnico 4 magnets.

Explore this instrument ↗

03 / Single & double cut

A focused combination.

The Junior listing specifies Spanish cedar for both body and neck, a Mojotone Quiet Coil P90, Grover tuning machines, CTS pots, and an Orange Drop capacitor.
